harper: Quick provenance + bench ask for the launch post and the live webinar demo. We need an auditable artifact that explains how numbers were produced (not just raw CSVs). Can runtime add a small provenance manifest and a short note for legal?
lucas: Yep. By provenance manifest you mean model checksum, exact kernel flags, docker image, and a reproducible run command?
harper: Exactly. Also add: which commit of the weights was used, model-card link, and an explicit note if any post-processing (reranking, temperature tweaking) was applied. We're trying to avoid back-and-forth with legal on claims.
sophia: We should also capture whether the runs used prefix caching and whether the benchmark included synthetic warmup traffic vs real requests. That affects cold vs warm claims.
lucas: Agreed. For the artifact set we'll produce: manifest_provenance.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_sample.csv (10 rows), README.md, p50_p95_p99.png, and a provenance_note.txt for legal.
ops-runner: Queued job 411900 on h100-medium. Smoke ETA ~1h. We'll label the artifact accordingly and upload to gs://redwood-marketing/provenance/5222223334/smoke_provenance.tar.gz when done. runtime-bot: job 411900 queued.
harper: For the legal note, please include exact wording options: a short conservative blurb (safe for press) and a technical blurb (for engineering readers). Legal prefers conservative first.
sophia: Example conservative blurb: "Measurements are single-run smoke artifacts on H100 with model-vX (int8) using the runtime's default warmup policy. Expect up to ±15% variability on tail percentiles in different environments." Technical blurb can include warmup windows, seed, qps.
lucas: We'll include both as separate files: legal_blurb.txt and technical_blurb.md. Also include the manifest fields: model_name, tag, checksum, commit_hash, docker_image, kernel_flags, quant_lib_version, run_seed, qps, tokens, warmup_policy, cache_config, job_id, GCS paths.
harper: Perfect. Also we want a short one-line "for sales" summary to attach to the lead packet: short bullet + contact.
ops-runner: Noted. We'll generate sales_snippet.txt: "Demo: median ~75ms (256 tokens, H100/int8). For tailored benchmarks email trials@redwood.com".
runtime-bot: job 411900 started.
ops-runner: Quick clarification: which qps for the short demo, and do you want streaming for the long demo?
harper: Short demo: 256 tokens @ 60 qps. Long demo: 2048 tokens streaming @ 10 qps and a non-streaming run for comparison. Warmup: 3 auto-batch windows then steady-state. Seed: mkting-provenance-2026 (I'll DM the file).
lucas: Got the seed. We'll tag runs as coldstart and warmed. For token trace sampling we'll pick mixed lengths to show token emission patterns.
sophia: Can you also include a tiny reproduction snippet in the README that legal/technical reviewers can run locally (docker run + env vars)? Helps reduce questions.
ops-runner: We'll add this example in README:
```
DOCKER_IMAGE=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime-bench:stable-2026 MODEL=model-vX-int8 CHECKSUM=sha256:abcd1234 RUN_SEED=mkting-provenance-2026 ./bench/run_smoke.sh --qps 60 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
lucas: One more: we should include a short paragraph explaining known nondeterministic factors and how they affect percentiles (scheduler noise, cache warming, transient telemetry gaps). That will help legal and marketing decide which numbers to call out.
harper: Yes. Add a recommended wording for press and a recommended conservative figure for the press headline (e.g., use p95 rather than median).
ops-runner: upload complete: gs://redwood-marketing/provenance/5222223334/smoke_provenance.tar.gz (4.7MB). runtime-bot: job 411900 finished successfully. Logs: gs://redwood-marketing/provenance/5222223334/logs/411900.log
mkt-asset-bot: artifact registered: gs://redwood-marketing/provenance/5222223334/smoke_provenance.tar.gz. Please approve for copy in the Launch > Assets doc.
harper: Downloading now. Will review legal_blurb + technical_blurb and post acceptance by EOD if wording is good.
sophia: If legal asks for additional conservative phrasing, we can toggle to p99-based claims instead. Keep me in the loop.
lucas: If marketing wants a follow-up run with prefix cache toggled off for a conservative baseline we can do that quickly (estimate ~45m).
harper: Great to know. Thanks everyone 44D. This provenance bundle should cut down the review cycles.
ops-runner: standing by for any rerun requests.
